purpose: Make developer-session interruption cheap and deterministic by separating durable work-in-progress checkpoints from the pull-request candidate head that owns expensive CI.
startupReadSet: exact-head workflow result only when candidate has been published
candidateCiRule: Recovery checkpoints go to the shadow recovery branch. The pull-request candidate branch moves only when one coherent atomic work unit is ready for exact-head validation.
unknownExternalCrashCause: Do not claim the platform interruption trigger is known without direct platform telemetry. Optimize the observable project-side amplification path instead.
